body.heading: Where in the world is Andorra?
paragraphs: Andorra is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Andorra is Andorra la Vella.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Andorra is Catalan.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Andorra is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Andorra?
paragraphs: Andorra covers about 468 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Liechtenstein.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Grandvalira is the largest ski area in the Pyrenees, with slopes for every level — in summer its lifts carry hikers and mountain bikers instead.
The capital is one of Europe's highest, a shopping and old-town stop beneath the peaks — and Caldea's steaming lagoons are a giant playground of warm water.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Andorra on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
